Question 2
?

The equation x2−4x+4=9 can be written in the form (x+p)2=q. Find p+q, and the sum of the roots x1+x2.

a
p+q=7,x1+x2=6
b
p+q=9,x1+x2=4
c
p+q=7,x1+x2=4
d
p+q=7,x1+x2=−4
e
p+q=−11x1+x2=4
